page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e-c1m2.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.e server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 2 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) mapped to a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU allocation is shared, and the system is equipped with 4.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the lower performance tiers. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1301.89, and the multi-core score is 1724.23, placing it in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 96.11 GB/sec, but this drops significantly to 2.0 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Geekbench scores reflect these constraints, with a single-core score of 737.0 and a multi-core score of 808.0. Static web serving throughput is measured at 0.28 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations reach 1.39 million operations per second.

Given the shared CPU allocation and modest hardware specifications, this instance represents a budget-oriented tier designed for low-intensity workloads. The resource density and performance profile make it suitable for lightweight applications that do not require sustained high CPU utilization or high-speed local storage. Appropriate workloads include basic web serving, small-scale development or testing environments, simple background tasks, and low-traffic database operations.
